name: Homestay a la Mode
source:
Three super cute foreign girls came to our school! Long live the exchange student system! I was so excited, but then I found out that their homestay was going to be at my house...

No, no, no, this can't be happening!

On top of that, one of them had to share a room with me! 

It was a sudden turn of events, without regard to my privacy. Thus the occasional impure cross-cultural exchange began.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1142898]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
三个超级可爱的外国女孩来到我们学校！交换生制度万岁！我本来兴奋不已，却得知，她们寄宿的地方竟然是我家……

不不不，这怎么行！

不仅如此，其中一个人还得与我同住一间房！

事情突然发展至此，根本没人顾及我的隐私。于是，一场偶尔夹杂不纯念头的跨文化交流就此开始。

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1142898]Getchu[/url]]
